newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 2.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 2.15 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 2.15 percent, or 1.81 points, to 85.84 on Tuesday. The Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index ended a provisional 73.68 points, or 1.90 percent up at 3,944.73.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market rose to 13.76 percent from 12.85 on Monday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
